title: The Sworn
text: Soldiers of Midgard, rebuilt on Brokkr's forge-table and given a god's name and a god's duty. Some keep more flesh than others.

title: The Fimbulwinter
text: Three winters with no summer between, the songs said. It has been three hundred. Midgard lives on the heat the dwarven forges send up the heat-lines.

title: The Iron Wood
text: Járnviðr: trees with bark like cast iron, where trolls were said to be born. The first heat-line runs through it.

title: Nidavellir
text: The dwarven forges under the mountain. Brokkr was born here, and swears he will die here, but not this year.

title: Hvergelmir
text: The boiling spring beneath the world, where every river begins. Its heat is the last heat there is.

title: Thralls
text: Rime-engines built small and cheap, sent in swarms. They circle to your back while their kin hold your eye.

title: Spikers
text: They keep their distance and throw ice. Close in and they retreat; cornered, they fight poorly.

title: Bulwarks
text: A tower shield on legs. Light blows and shots break on it. Heavy blows, a launcher, or a step behind it do not.

title: Frostwrights
text: Engines of cold that freeze the ground and loose shards that follow you. Near death they glow white and burst. Leave them.

title: Menders
text: They tether a shield to whichever ally is worst off. Cut the tether by staggering them, or kill them first.

title: Iron Trolls
text: Break the arms and they stop throwing. Break a leg and they kneel, and a kneeling troll can be climbed.

title: Burrowers
text: They travel under the ice and come up beneath you. Watch for the cracks; a slam brings them up early.

title: The Valkyries
text: They carry the fallen Sworn home to the last waystone. Their price is a tenth of what you carried since; you can take it back where you fell.

title: Wells of Wyrd
text: The Norns keep one rule in each well. Win under it and the well pays in sigils and blueprints.

title: Hrungnir
text: A jotun of the old songs, rebuilt as a war-engine with a forge for a heart. It drank the spring's heat to wake the giants under the ice. Its plates turn most of a blow; its heart, when it vents, turns nothing. It watches how you fight, and answers.

title: Mökkurkálfi
text: The clay giant built to stand beside Hrungnir, given a mare's heart because nothing braver would fit. It mends its master's stone with long, slow spells, and a solid blow breaks its nerve.

title: Chapter one: the winter breaks
text: The heat-lines run again and Midgard thaws from the wall inward. Under the ice of Hvergelmir the giants sleep on. The gate will take you back to the caldera if you want Hrungnir's stone a second time.
